title: Stereo blend
description: Two synthesized timbres blend through complementary gain curves drawn on a blue instrument surface.
useCase: Compare or combine timbres without the center level collapsing.
interaction: Enable sound and move the equal-power blend control.
reducedMotion: Gain changes retain short audio ramps that prevent clicks; the diagram redraws directly.
limitations: Two local oscillators, not uploaded tracks. Equal-power gain law does not guarantee equal perceived loudness for all timbres.
look: Saturated cobalt-blue panel with a thin white grid, crossing cream and pale-blue gain curves, a red vertical marker, a range slider and monospace percentages.
motion: Dragging the blend slider moves a red marker and two dots along cosine and sine gain curves directly, while oscillator gains glide with a 25 ms time constant.
adapt: Gains follow `Math.cos`/`Math.sin` of `blend` (scaled by 0.045) and ramp via `setTargetAtTime` with a 0.025 s constant; the SVG curves, marker and dots derive from the same `blend`. Swap the two `createOscillator` tones (220 and 330 Hz) for real audio sources.
